dedupe_keys.name: unsd energy statistics database annual energy balances of 230 countries and areas since 1950

description: The UNSD Energy Statistics Database, maintained by the United Nations Statistics Division, holds annual statistics on the production, trade, transformation and end-use consumption of solid, liquid and gaseous fuels, electricity and heat for more than 230 countries and territories from 1950 onwards. Values are stored in original units such as tonnes and GWh and as calorific values in terajoules for comparison across fuels; each row carries country code, product code, flow code, year, unit, an estimate flag and the value. The main source is the UNSD Annual Questionnaire on Energy Statistics completed by national statistical offices. Access: the full database is a delimited TXT file ordered through the United Nations Shop (US$600 for a single user, 20 percent academic discount) with code lists and conversion factors; free Excel dashboards show world and regional trends to 2023, and an SDMX API is documented in the API manual. Licence: UN terms allow free copying and redistribution with UNSD cited. Caveats: annual national resolution only, reporting lags and gaps differ by country, and some values are estimates. It suits national supply-demand baselines and scenario inputs, complementing the JODI oil and gas databases and Eurostat energy statistics catalogued here.
